title: DEMO — Priya Sharma quarterly portfolio review transcript
disclaimer: Synthetic demo transcript for Advisor Pulse demos. Not a real client recording.
full_text:
Advisor: Good morning Priya, thanks for joining. Today I want to review your retirement goal progress and the mid-cap allocation drift we flagged.
Client: Morning. Yes, I saw the alert — I'm a bit concerned about mid-cap volatility after the last few months.
Advisor: Understood. Your portfolio is behind the expected path for the retirement goal, and mid-cap is overweight versus the agreed moderate policy. Active return versus benchmark has also lagged in the recent window.
Client: Has my retirement timeline changed? Not really — still aiming for the same date. But I may need some liquidity next year for my daughter's education deposit.
Advisor: That's helpful. We should not treat that as distress, but we should plan cash and avoid overreacting to short-term mid-cap noise. My recommendation is to review a rebalancing plan that trims mid-cap toward policy and keeps your SIP on track.
Client: I'm not ready to approve a full rebalance today. I want to see a written proposal first.
Advisor: Fair. I will prepare a revised allocation proposal and send it within one week. Meanwhile, can we keep the current SIP amount?
Client: Yes, keep the SIP for now. Please also schedule a follow-up after I review the proposal.
Advisor: Agreed. Action items: I will send the rebalancing proposal by next week; you will review and confirm preference; we will book a short follow-up. Any other concerns?
Client: Mainly clarity on downside if markets stay weak. I'm okay with equity overall, just not comfortable with so much mid-cap.
Advisor: Perfect — we'll address that in the proposal. Thanks Priya.
